name: Godaigo
definition: A hexagon-tile strategy board game built around six elemental scroll types (Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, Void, Catacomb) and tactical positioning, playable solo or against other people.
edit: Added automated vulnerability scanning to the build.
plans: Next: finish the Wandering River scroll effect, then reaction-phase support.

name: 168 Hours
definition: A time-tracking PWA that pings you at random moments to ask what you're doing right now, building an honest picture of your week without manual logging.
edit: Made the check-in history collapsible — last 7 days, with a Show all option.
plans: Next: a radial 168-hour wheel chart, plus day-streak tracking.

name: Word Search Maker
definition: A word search generator with a twist: some grids hide a secret word encoded across two different fonts instead of printing it outright.
edit: Fixed the hidden Sunday answer re-hiding itself when Reveal gets toggled back off.
plans: Next: more puzzle variants beyond the font-encoded hidden word.

name: General Psychology Study Fund
definition: Not a coded project — a personal pledge to put real time and money toward psychology coursework and research. It promises nothing on its own; it's only as real as the support that keeps it up.
plans: Keep showing up for it, one study session at a time.

name: Touch Grass
definition: Not a coded project — a personal pledge to spend less time at a screen and more time actually outside.
edit: Still slowly losing ground to the todo list.
